title: Housing & Neighborhood Revitalization
description: Use this service request to request assistance or information related to home repair, Dallas Home Assistance Program, first time home buyers program, or the Major System Repair Program (roofing, electrical, plumbing/gas, and HVAC.) The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.
department: Office of Housing and Community Empowerment

observedQuestions.prompt: What is the nature of your concern?
Which Major System Repair Program are you inquiring about?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Nature = Major system repair program; subtype = Other; description supplied

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for home repair or housing-program assistance and information.
actions.why: For assistance or information about home repair, the Dallas Home Assistance Program, the first-time home buyers program, or the Major System Repair Program for roofing, electrical, plumbing or gas, heating, or air conditioning. The 311 request form asks which program or repair type the inquiry concerns.
actions.who: Office of Housing and Community Empowerment
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Housing and Community Concerns" > Choose "Housing & Neighborhood Revitalization"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Housing and Community Concerns" > Choose "Housing & Neighborhood Revitalization"
